intro: Hi! Here are nine options for your website. Use the arrows to go through them. Each one is a real page you can scroll and click.
For now each option is its home page only. The other pages get built once you choose.
For each one, tell me here what you like and what you don't. Short notes are perfect.
Tap Favorite on the one you like best.
At the end, either pick one and go with it, or pick the things you like from several, and leave me a note on how to move forward.

options.name: The Cutting Mat
options.line: Your work table seen from above: everything is cut paper on the green mat.

options.name: The Gallery Wall
options.line: Calm and collector-first: the piece assembles from fragments as the page opens.

options.name: Sticker Pop
options.line: Loud and playful: your cut-outs are stickers you can drag around.

options.name: The Poster
options.line: A living poster: one giant word per screen with your cut-outs in front of it.

options.name: The Archive
options.line: Your things on a dark table: objects you can move, pieces as captioned prints.

options.name: Inside the Piece
options.line: Your art fills the screen and a clean page floats inside it.

options.name: The Cover
options.line: Every screen is a magazine cover: a huge word behind a figure on flat colour.

options.name: The Floor
options.line: A floor covered in your prints that you drag across, with a small map.

options.name: The Orbit
options.line: Your pieces circle the headline on a ring, like the planet in your logo.
